name: Digital Mine
description:
We initially created 100 000 DGM in total.

This want to be an asset token, and we decided to connect it with our mining and staking activities on multiple blockchains.

We are currently operating, and producing:
1) Chia (XCH)
2) Tron (TRX)
3) Hive
4) Steem
5) Phala (PHA)
6) Evmos
 
We are planning to add Cosmos (ATOM) and Osmosis (OSMO) very soon.

We will offer a weekly payout to all the DGM holders, that will hold a minimum of 100 DGM in their wallet. The payout will be in Chia (XCH) token, and it will be calculated based on the total number of DGM holders, the total amount in circulation, and our mining results.

We are confident of being able to offer a generous APR from 30% to 50%, but the effective APR will vary based on the mining results, that are really unpredictable variables.

We will convert all the coins we produce in XCH in order to perform the weekly payout to our holders.

We will release 1 000 DGM on the internal decentralized XCH exchange each time until the whole batch will go sold out, and we will keep doing this until the whole supply will be sold out, after that we will decide together with the holders if creating another 100 000 DGM or not.

For more information please join us on discord:  https://discord.gg/TUZjFwQknB/8UtTcqFC5d
